snippet.title: 'Love & Country' Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
'Love & Country' is finally coming to you in full June 20th, 2024!  Available on Steam for Mac/PC.

Be sure to check out our socials for more info in the upcoming weeks! Thank you for all your support 💕

Art by Juliana Parks (@pr1nsass)
Editing by Katie Beiter
Music By Zachary Pinkham (www.zacharypinkham.com)
Featuring the vocal talents of:
Leah Booth (@lil_leahbee on instagram)
James Aaron Oh (www.jamesaaronoh.com)
Tim Winters (@timandhisvoices on Twitter)
Voice Casting through Very Berry Studios (https://veryberrystudios.com)
